answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a ledge seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank therefore goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 29 aliases trips the duplicate check at the haven gate. The delta receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. Honest users pay that once, farms 34 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
